description: Dynamic UTM tracking for LinkedIn ads: parameters LinkedIn appends to every ad’s landing page on a campaign (or, level:"account", across the whole ad account), filled in per click. standard:true sets utm_source=linkedin, utm_medium=paid_social, utm_campaign={campaign name}, utm_content={creative id}. Or pass dynamic {key: ACCOUNT_ID | ACCOUNT_NAME | CAMPAIGN_GROUP_ID | CAMPAIGN_GROUP_NAME | CAMPAIGN_ID | CAMPAIGN_NAME | CREATIVE_ID | CREATIVE_NAME} and/or custom {key: fixed value}. A new set REPLACES the previous one; clear:true removes it; call with no parameters to read what is set. Ads do not go back through review. Read back from LinkedIn. Free.

adAccountId.description: LinkedIn ad account id shared with this profile; needed only when several are shared

campaignId.description: campaign to set tracking on; omit for account-level tracking with level account

clear.description: true removes all dynamic tracking parameters

custom.description: UTM key mapped to a fixed value, e.g. {utm_source: newsletter}; a new set replaces the old

dynamic.description: UTM key mapped to a LinkedIn macro, e.g. {utm_campaign: CAMPAIGN_NAME}; a new set replaces the old

level.description: default campaign when campaignId is given

standard.description: true sets the standard UTM set: source linkedin, medium paid_social, campaign and content filled per click

name: set_linkedin_ads_tracking
title: LinkedIn ads dynamic UTM tracking
